fail_closed_classifications.candidate-entry-discriminator-passes: Selected fetch identity, final pre-restore identity, restore proof, and nonce-bearing minimal-entry-control-ready appear in the retained serial window; may select narrowed v14 candidate entry preflight but not packet-I/O/OpenSSH.
fail_closed_classifications.blocked-control-entry: Selected fetch succeeds but the minimal control marker is absent.
fail_closed_classifications.blocked-identity: Selected fetch bytes/hash, final pre-restore identity, or selected mirror identity disagree.
fail_closed_classifications.blocked-tftp-capture: The TFTP/log window cannot prove selected da591740/kernel_2712.img bytes before restore.
fail_closed_classifications.blocked-restore: Restore proof is missing or disagrees.
fail_closed_classifications.inconclusive-with-required-discriminator: The first missing fact is named and no same-shaped retry is selected without supervisor planning.
